messages.message: React Hook useEffect has missing dependencies: 'onClose' and 'onCreated'. Either include them or remove the dependency array. If 'onCreated' changes too often, find the parent component that defines it and wrap that definition in useCallback.

suggestions.desc: Update the dependencies array to be: [open, draftId, importDraftId, operatorId, operatorRole, onCreated, onClose]

fix.text: [open, draftId, importDraftId, operatorId, operatorRole, onCreated, onClose]
